note: Phase 7 is executed by one owner on one living integration branch, so there is a single lane. The manifest exists because ownership is what makes 'may this change touch that file' a checkable property (EP-002, EP-004), and because contract, generated and forbidden paths must be explicit even when nobody can race for them.

forbiddenRationale.js/semantics/ir/**: The semantic IR, CFG, SSA and MemorySSA contracts are Phase 3/6 truth. Phase 7 consumes them through their published seams; changing them to make a new analysis fit would create a second semantic engine (P7-INV-007).
forbiddenRationale.js/targets/architecture/**: Architecture-specific decoding stays behind the target boundary. A generic alias/type/summary/discovery change that needs a decoder edit is leaking architecture semantics into the central solver (P7-INV-007, FM-9).
forbiddenRationale.js/core/identity/**: Artifact and instruction identity is a Phase 0/4 contract; Phase 7 keys artifacts with it rather than redefining it.
forbiddenRationale.js/platform/capability-maturity.js: Phase 7 reads capability truth to build its corpus manifest. Promoting maturity is a separate, evidence-backed change.
forbiddenRationale.docs/HEX_MASTER_ARCHITECTURE.md: A phase may not edit the contract it is being judged against.
forbiddenRationale.tests/phase6/**: Earlier-phase evidence may be re-run but not rewritten by Phase 7.

ownedWithConstraint.js/semantics/compat/index.js: May be updated only to route the canonical semantic pipeline's alias/region providers through the Phase 7 solver. The pipeline's structure, ordering and validation calls must not change.
ownedWithConstraint.package.json: May add Phase 7 scripts and wire them into existing aggregates. Must not remove or weaken an existing gate.
ownedWithConstraint.docs/PHASE7_STATIC_ANALYSIS_EXECUTION_PL: May be updated only to record that the runbook has been executed and to point at live evidence. Its invariants and exit gates must not be relaxed.
ownedWithConstraint.userscript/hex.user.template.js: Generated output. It MUST be produced by the canonical builder (npm run userscript:build) and committed by the integration owner after each accepted checkpoint. It must never be hand-edited or copied from another branch.
ownedWithConstraint.userscript/release-version.json: Generated release identity. It advances deterministically from protected runtime content and must never be edited by hand.

generatedOutputNote: Phase 7 edits js/analysis/** and js/semantics/compat/index.js, which are part of the protected userscript runtime, so the canonical userscript build output changes with every accepted checkpoint. Phase 7 is a single-owner phase and is therefore also the release owner: it MUST complete the generated-output transaction itself (rebuild with the canonical builder, commit, rebuild again and require a zero diff) before accepting the next dependent checkpoint. Changing protected runtime source without rebuilding is a merge-blocking desync (EP-003, EP-008, EP-009). js/userscript/deployment-identity.generated.js is deliberately not owned here: it records the commit a deployment was built from, is written by the Workers build, and differs between a local build and a CI checkout by design. The canonical generated-sync workflow excludes it for the same reason.
